audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Are peers penalized for sending over-cap transactions?
audit_items.reason: Component mismatch: Transaction gas limit validation is an Execution Layer (EL) concern. Prysm is a Consensus Layer (CL) client that does not implement transaction validation or gas limit enforcement. These operations are performed by the execution client (e.g., Geth, Nethermind) that Prysm communicates with via the Engine API.
